<!-- proofline:finding-series=01a202cb-23c8-7508-9b63-96f9215a60cc -->
**Serious** · Report names with commas or line breaks corrupt CSV exports

`write_export` joins raw field values without CSV quoting.

A report name containing a comma or line break can turn one delivery into extra columns or records.

Keep streaming the query results, but write each row with `csv.writer.writerow`.

[View finding in Proofline](https://proofline.sh/orgs/by-id/01a202a0-cd61-7684-99bc-53c775b0de50/reviews/01a202ca-41c5-70b7-a064-c299489b96d6/findings/01a202cb-23d1-73c9-9f12-69115957a0e1)

findings.body:
<!-- proofline:finding-series=01a202cb-23c3-758a-939b-393a58a393bc -->
**Warning** · Blocked export output can make scheduling fail

This change writes export rows to stdout while the SQLite read cursor is still active, holding a read lock if output stalls in default rollback-journal mode.

A concurrent `schedule` can exceed SQLite’s busy timeout and exit with an unhandled `OperationalError` at commit.

Exhaust the `SELECT` cursor before writing delivery rows to stdout.

[View finding in Proofline](https://proofline.sh/orgs/by-id/01a202a0-cd61-7684-99bc-53c775b0de50/reviews/01a202ca-41c5-70b7-a064-c299489b96d6/findings/01a202cb-23c9-73f8-9121-f6737a99e713)
